entities.name: StateSchema
entities.description: Root schema of the application's global store state. Composes feature slices (counter, user, ui) plus the RTK Query API cache state registered under a dynamic reducerPath key. It also defines the supporting ThunkExtraArg (AxiosInstance api client injected into thunks) and ThunkConfig<T> (typed thunk configuration with state, extra, and rejectValue).

properties.name: counter
properties.description: State slice for the Counter feature

properties.name: user
properties.description: State slice for the User feature (imported from @/entities/User)

properties.name: ui
properties.description: State slice for UI feature state (imported from @/features/UI)

properties.name: [rtkApi.reducerPath]
properties.description: Dynamic key holding RTK Query API cache state, keyed by the rtkApi reducerPath

relationships.description: Global state contains the Counter feature slice
Global state contains the User feature slice
Global state contains the UI feature slice
Global state contains RTK Query cache state under the dynamic rtkApi.reducerPath key

validations: State must include the counter, user, and ui feature slices
API state must be registered under the dynamic key rtkApi.reducerPath so RTK Query caching works
Thunk extra argument (ThunkExtraArg) must expose an api client of type AxiosInstance
Thunks using ThunkConfig<T> must supply a typed rejectValue T for rejection handling

scenarios.name: Store initialization
scenarios.given: Feature reducers for counter, user, and ui plus the rtkApi reducer
scenarios.when: The StoreProvider creates the Redux store
scenarios.then: The resulting store state conforms to StateSchema
and: API cache state is accessible under rtkApi.reducerPath

scenarios.name: Thunk execution with typed config
scenarios.given: A thunk typed with ThunkConfig<T>
scenarios.then: It receives state: StateSchema and extra: ThunkExtraArg containing the AxiosInstance api client
and: It can reject with a typed value of T via rejectValue

entities.name: Counter
entities.description: Represents a simple counter entity holding a single numeric value, used as the state schema for the Counter feature.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The current numeric value of the counter

validations: value is required and must be of type number

scenarios.name: Read counter value
scenarios.given: A CounterSchema state exists
scenarios.then: a numeric value is returned

entities.name: User
entities.description: Represents the authenticated user of the application. The User type is defined in src/entities/User/model/types/user. Initialization of auth data (fetching the current user on app startup) is currently a stub (placeholder) that is not yet implemented; planned implementations include cookie/session (GET /auth/me), JWT (token check with refresh), or OAuth (code-for-token exchange).
validations: initAuthData thunk must either resolve with a User object or reject with an error string
The concrete shape of User properties is not visible in the provided sources and cannot be verified

scenarios.name: Initialize auth data (stub not implemented)
scenarios.given: Application startup dispatches the user/initAuthData thunk
scenarios.when: the thunk executes in its current stub form
scenarios.then: it rejects with the value 'Не реализовано' (Not implemented)

scenarios.name: Auth initialization error handling
scenarios.given: The future real auth initialization request throws an exception
scenarios.then: it rejects with 'Ошибка инициализации авторизации' (Auth initialization error)

scenarios.name: Initialize auth data once implemented
scenarios.given: The thunk is implemented to call GET /auth/me via the injected api
scenarios.then: the returned User data is dispatched as the fulfilled payload

entities.name: UISchema
entities.description: Represents the UI state schema for the application, tracking scroll positions per page address.

properties.name: scroll
properties.description: Map of page addresses to their saved scroll positions

relationships.description: UISchema contains a ScrollSchema map under its 'scroll' property

validations: scroll must be a record object mapping page address keys to numeric values
Each scroll position value must be a number

scenarios.name: Save scroll position for a page
scenarios.given: A user has scrolled a page to a given offset
scenarios.when: The scroll position is recorded in the UI schema
scenarios.then: The scroll map contains an entry keyed by the page address with the numeric scroll offset as its value

scenarios.name: Look up scroll position for a page
scenarios.given: The scroll map contains an entry for a specific page address
scenarios.when: The page address is looked up in the scroll map
scenarios.then: The saved numeric scroll offset for that address is returned

entities.name: ScrollSchema
entities.description: A record mapping page addresses (URLs/paths) to their scroll positions expressed as numeric offsets.

properties.name: pageAddress
properties.description: The page address used as the record key identifying a visited page

properties.name: scrollPosition
properties.description: The numeric scroll position (offset) associated with the page address

relationships.description: ScrollSchema is embedded as the 'scroll' property of UISchema

validations: Keys must be page address strings and unique within the record
Values must be numbers representing scroll positions

scenarios.name: Record scroll offset for a page address
scenarios.given: The scroll record for the application UI state
scenarios.when: A page at address '/articles' is scrolled to offset 500
scenarios.then: The ScrollSchema entry maps '/articles' to the number 500

scenarios.name: Independent entries per page address
scenarios.given: Scroll positions saved for multiple page addresses
scenarios.when: Each page address is queried in the record
scenarios.then: Each address returns its own independent numeric scroll position

services.name: AboutPage
services.purpose: Provides the About page screen of the application. The module acts as the public entry point (barrel) for the About page feature, re-exporting the AboutPage UI component from its ui/ subfolder for consumption by the router/pages layer.

operations.name: renderAboutPage
operations.description: SHALL render the About page view when the component is mounted by the application router, displaying informational content about the application.
outputs: ReactElement representing the About page UI

scenarios.name: About page renders successfully

scenarios.then: The About page content is displayed without errors

scenarios.name: Snapshot stability
scenarios.given: Unchanged About page implementation
scenarios.then: Rendered output matches the expected structure

operations.name: exportPublicApi
operations.description: SHALL expose the default export of ./ui/AboutPage as the named export 'AboutPage', serving as the module's public API so consumers import only from the module root.

scenarios.name: Named re-export available
scenarios.given: The ui/AboutPage module has a default export
scenarios.then: The AboutPage component from ./ui/AboutPage is returned

services.name: AdminPanelPage
services.purpose: Public API barrel for the Admin Panel page module. It re-exports the AdminPanelPage UI component as the module's public export so the router and other application layers can consume the admin panel page without depending on its internal file structure.

operations.name: exposeAdminPanelPage
operations.description: The module SHALL re-export the default AdminPanelPage component from './ui/AdminPanelPage' as a named export, establishing the module's public API surface.

scenarios.name: Barrel re-export resolves
scenarios.given: The UI component exists at './ui/AdminPanelPage' with a default export
scenarios.then: The AdminPanelPage UI component is provided

scenarios.name: Internal path hidden
scenarios.given: A consumer imports from the module index
scenarios.then: Only the public export surface is exposed and internal file layout is not leaked

operations.name: render
operations.description: The AdminPanelPage component SHALL render the admin panel page UI when mounted, serving as the page-level container for admin panel functionality.
outputs: ReactElement representing the admin panel page

scenarios.name: Page renders on admin route
scenarios.given: The application navigates to the admin panel route
scenarios.then: Admin panel page content is rendered to the DOM

services.name: AppEntry
services.purpose: Static HTML shell of the single-page application. Defines the document structure, provides the #root mount point, and triggers loading of the client application module to bootstrap the UI.

operations.name: bootstrapApplication
operations.description: SHALL load the application entry module (/src/index.tsx) as an ES module in the browser so the client application can render into the #root container.

scenarios.name: Initial page load
scenarios.given: index.html is served to a browser
scenarios.when: The module script /src/index.tsx is fetched and executed
scenarios.then: The application initializes and renders into the #root container

scenarios.name: Static shell served
scenarios.given: The application bundle has not yet loaded
scenarios.then: An empty #root element and UTF-8 English document shell are presented with no content

sideEffects: Browser fetches and executes /src/index.tsx as an ES module
DOM manipulation into the #root element by the loaded application

services.name: AppLink
services.purpose: Reusable navigation link component that wraps react-router-dom's NavLink, providing variant-based visual styling (primary/red) and conditional active-state CSS class application for navigation UI.
sideEffects: Triggers client-side route navigation via react-router-dom NavLink when clicked (updates browser URL/history)

services.name: Button
services.purpose: Reusable shared UI button component that renders a native HTML button with configurable visual variant (clear/outline/filled), design-system size (m/l/xl), semantic color (normal/success/error), square/fullWidth layout flags, disabled state, and left/right addon slots; forwards refs and passes through all native button attributes.

services.name: BabelRemovePropsPlugin
services.purpose: Build-time Babel plugin that strips forbidden JSX props (e.g. test-id attributes) from component code during compilation.
sideEffects: Mutates Babel AST during build transformation

services.name: JestEmptyComponent
services.purpose: Provides a minimal pass-through div component used as a lightweight mock/stub component inside Jest tests.

services.name: CustomJSDOMEnvironment
services.purpose: Custom Jest test environment that extends the Node environment with a happy-dom Window, exposing browser-like globals (document, location, storage, fetch) to test suites.

operations.name: setup
operations.description: The environment SHALL initialize the Node environment, create a happy-dom Window (localhost, 1920x1080), and assign browser globals such as window, document, navigator, location, history, Element, HTMLElement, localStorage, sessionStorage, XMLSerializer, fetch, Request, Response, Headers, URL, and DOMException onto the test global object. It SHALL also polyfill TextEncoder/TextDecoder from Node's util when missing.
outputs: this.window set to the happy-dom Window

scenarios.name: Browser globals exposed
scenarios.given: The environment is being initialized for a test run
scenarios.then: window, document, navigator, location, history, localStorage, sessionStorage and fetch are defined on the global object
and: The happy-dom Window is configured with url http://localhost and viewport 1920x1080

scenarios.name: TextEncoder polyfill applied
scenarios.given: global.TextEncoder is undefined
scenarios.then: Node's util TextEncoder is assigned to the global object

scenarios.name: Existing globals preserved
scenarios.given: global.TextDecoder is already defined
scenarios.then: The existing TextDecoder implementation is not overwritten

operations.name: teardown
operations.description: The environment SHALL close the happy-dom Window (if present) and then delegate cleanup to the parent Node environment teardown.

scenarios.name: Window closed on teardown
scenarios.given: setup has run and a happy-dom window exists
scenarios.then: window.close() is invoked and the Node environment teardown completes

scenarios.name: Teardown tolerates missing window
scenarios.given: The window was never created or is already closed
scenarios.then: No error is thrown and super teardown still executes

sideEffects: Creates and disposes a happy-dom Window per test run
Mutates the Jest global sandbox with browser globals

services.name: SetupTests
services.purpose: Global Jest bootstrap module that registers jest-dom DOM matchers on expect and loads the regenerator-runtime polyfill for all test suites.
sideEffects: Extends Jest's expect matchers globally for all tests
Loads regenerator-runtime polyfill into the test runtime

services.name: CounterSlice
services.purpose: Redux slice that owns the counter state (CounterSchema), providing pure state transitions for incrementing and decrementing the counter value.

operations.name: increment
operations.description: The reducer SHALL increase the counter value by one when the increment action is dispatched.
outputs: state: CounterSchema with value increased by 1

scenarios.name: Increment from zero
scenarios.given: Counter value is 0
scenarios.then: Counter value becomes 1

scenarios.name: Increment from positive value
scenarios.given: Counter value is 5
scenarios.then: Counter value becomes 6

operations.name: decrement
operations.description: The reducer SHALL decrease the counter value by one when the decrement action is dispatched.
outputs: state: CounterSchema with value decreased by 1

scenarios.name: Decrement from positive value
scenarios.given: Counter value is 5
scenarios.then: Counter value becomes 4

scenarios.name: Decrement below zero
scenarios.given: Counter value is 0
scenarios.then: Counter value becomes -1

operations.name: counterReducer
operations.description: The reducer SHALL return the existing state unchanged for unknown actions and SHALL initialize the counter state with a default value when state is undefined.

scenarios.name: Unknown action leaves state intact
scenarios.given: Counter value is 3
scenarios.then: Counter value remains 3

scenarios.name: Initial state default
scenarios.given: No counter state exists in the store
scenarios.then: Counter state is created with a default value

sideEffects: Updates the counter slice in the global Redux store

services.name: Counter
services.purpose: UI component that displays the current counter value and provides increment/decrement controls that dispatch actions to the counter slice.

operations.name: render
operations.description: The component SHALL read the current counter value from the Redux store and display it.
inputs: counter value from Redux store state
outputs: Rendered counter value in the UI

scenarios.name: Displays current counter value
scenarios.given: Counter state value is 10
scenarios.then: The value 10 is displayed to the user

operations.name: increment
operations.description: The component SHALL dispatch the increment action when the increment control is activated.
outputs: Dispatched increment action to Redux store

scenarios.name: Increment control clicked
scenarios.given: Counter component is rendered
scenarios.then: Increment action is dispatched
and: Displayed counter value increases by 1

operations.name: decrement
operations.description: The component SHALL dispatch the decrement action when the decrement control is activated.
outputs: Dispatched decrement action to Redux store

scenarios.name: Decrement control clicked
scenarios.given: Counter component is rendered
scenarios.then: Decrement action is dispatched
and: Displayed counter value decreases by 1

sideEffects: Dispatches Redux actions mutating the counter slice in the global store

services.name: EnLocale
services.purpose: Provides the English (en) translation catalog for the application. It maps Russian source keys to English UI strings across i18n namespaces (translation, about, main), supplying localized text for navigation, pages, error screens, counter controls, and language labels.

operations.name: translate
operations.description: SHALL resolve a UI string key to its English equivalent within the default 'translation' namespace, covering main page, about, admin panel, error page, not-found page, counter controls, and language labels.

scenarios.name: Page title translation
scenarios.given: Key 'Главная страница' exists in translation.json
scenarios.when: translate is invoked with that key
scenarios.then: Returns 'Main page'

scenarios.name: Navigation translation
scenarios.given: Keys 'Главная', 'О сайте', 'Админ панель' exist in translation.json
scenarios.when: translate is invoked for each navigation key
scenarios.then: Returns 'Main', 'About us', and 'Admin panel' respectively

scenarios.name: Error screen translations
scenarios.given: Keys 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка' and 'Обновить страницу' exist
scenarios.when: translate is invoked for the error page
scenarios.then: Returns 'An unexpected error has occurred' and 'Reload page'

scenarios.name: Counter control labels
scenarios.given: Keys 'increment', 'decrement', 'add5' exist in translation.json
scenarios.then: Returns 'increment' verbatim

scenarios.name: Missing key fallback
scenarios.given: A key is not present in translation.json
scenarios.when: translate is invoked with that key
scenarios.then: Returns the key itself as the fallback value

operations.name: translateAbout
operations.description: SHALL resolve keys for the About page within the 'about' namespace, providing translations for the page title, admin panel link, and access-denied message.

scenarios.name: About page title
scenarios.given: Key 'О сайте' exists in about.json
scenarios.then: Returns 'About us'

scenarios.name: Untranslated key falls back to source
scenarios.given: Keys 'Админ панель' and 'У вас нет доступа к этой странице' map to their Russian source text in about.json
scenarios.when: translateAbout is invoked with those keys
scenarios.then: Returns the original Russian strings unchanged as untranslated placeholders

scenarios.name: Namespace fallback to default translations
scenarios.given: A key exists in translation.json but not in about.json
scenarios.when: translateAbout is invoked with that key
scenarios.then: Resolves the value from the default translation namespace

operations.name: translateMain
operations.description: SHALL resolve keys for the Main page within the 'main' namespace; since the namespace is empty, it MUST fall back to the key or the default translation namespace.

scenarios.name: Empty namespace fallback
scenarios.given: main.json contains no entries
scenarios.when: translateMain is invoked with any key
scenarios.then: Falls back to the default translation namespace or returns the key itself

operations.name: provideLocaleBundle
operations.description: SHALL expose the complete English resource bundle (translation, about, main namespaces) for registration with the i18n system and selection via the language switcher.
outputs: resources: { translation: object, about: object, main: object }

scenarios.name: Bundle includes all namespaces
scenarios.given: The en locale files exist under public/locales/en/
scenarios.then: Returns a bundle containing the 'translation', 'about', and 'main' namespaces
and: The 'translation' namespace contains 13 key-value pairs
The 'about' namespace contains 3 key-value pairs
The 'main' namespace is an empty object

scenarios.name: Language label identifies locale
scenarios.given: Keys 'Язык' and 'Короткий язык' exist in translation.json
scenarios.when: the language switcher renders using the en bundle
scenarios.then: Displays 'English' as the full label and 'En' as the short label

sideEffects: Locale files are served as static assets from public/locales/en/ and fetched over HTTP by the i18n resource loader

services.name: ErrorBoundaryPublicApi
services.purpose: Public entry point (index.ts) of the ErrorBoundary provider module; exposes the ErrorBoundary component and BugButton testing utility for app-level composition.

operations.name: exportPublicApi
operations.description: SHALL expose ErrorBoundary and BugButton as the module's public API surface so consumers import them from a single path.

scenarios.name: Module import
scenarios.given: A consumer needs error-handling components
scenarios.then: ErrorBoundary and BugButton are both available for use

services.name: ErrorBoundary
services.purpose: React class-based error boundary component that catches runtime errors anywhere in its child component tree, prevents full application crash, and renders a fallback UI.

operations.name: captureChildError
operations.description: SHALL capture errors thrown by any descendant component and transition the boundary into an error state.

scenarios.name: Error in child component
scenarios.given: ErrorBoundary is rendering children normally
scenarios.when: A descendant component throws a rendering error
scenarios.then: Boundary state hasError becomes true and the application does not crash

scenarios.name: Healthy render
scenarios.given: Children render without errors
scenarios.then: Boundary state hasError remains false

operations.name: logCaughtError
operations.description: SHOULD log the caught error and error info for diagnostics when React invokes the error lifecycle.

scenarios.name: Error captured
scenarios.given: An error was caught by the boundary
scenarios.when: React invokes the error lifecycle callback
scenarios.then: Error details and component stack are logged to the console

operations.name: renderFallback
operations.description: MUST render a fallback UI when the boundary is in the error state, and render children unchanged otherwise.

scenarios.name: Error state
scenarios.given: state.hasError is true
scenarios.then: A fallback error message/page is displayed instead of the crashed subtree

scenarios.name: Normal state
scenarios.given: state.hasError is false
scenarios.then: Children are rendered as-is

sideEffects: Logs caught errors and error info to console

services.name: BugButton
services.purpose: Developer testing utility button that deliberately throws a runtime error when clicked, used to verify that the ErrorBoundary displays its fallback UI.

operations.name: throwTestError
operations.description: SHALL throw a runtime error on user click so the wrapping ErrorBoundary can be exercised and verified.

scenarios.name: Trigger error
scenarios.given: BugButton is rendered inside an ErrorBoundary
scenarios.then: An error is thrown and the boundary switches to its fallback UI

scenarios.name: Idle state
scenarios.given: The button has not been clicked
scenarios.then: No error is thrown and the button is displayed normally

sideEffects: Throws a deliberate runtime error to trigger the error boundary

services.name: ErrorPage
services.purpose: Renders a fallback error page UI when the application encounters an unhandled error, informing the user that something went wrong and offering an action to reload the page and recover application state.

operations.name: renderErrorPage
operations.description: SHALL render a localized error message and a reload action button whenever the error page is displayed as a result of an unhandled application error.
outputs: ReactElement (error page UI with message and reload button)

scenarios.name: Error page displayed
scenarios.given: The application encountered an unhandled error and the error page is shown
scenarios.then: A localized 'Something went wrong' message is displayed
and: A reload action button is presented to the user
The rendered output is a valid React element

scenarios.name: Localized content
scenarios.given: The active application language is set (e.g., en or ru)
scenarios.then: The error message and button label are shown in the active language

operations.name: reloadPage
operations.description: SHALL reload the current browser page when the user activates the reload action, resetting the application to a clean state.

scenarios.name: User triggers reload
scenarios.given: The error page is displayed with the reload button visible
scenarios.when: The user clicks the reload button
scenarios.then: The browser reloads the current page
and: Application state is reinitialized on reload
The user is returned to the application entry state

sideEffects: Reloads the browser page via location.reload() when the reload action is triggered

services.name: ForbiddenPage
services.purpose: Public API module for the Forbidden page; encapsulates presentation of the '403 Forbidden / access denied' screen shown when a user attempts to reach a resource without sufficient permissions, and exposes the ForbiddenPage UI component as the module's public entry point.

operations.name: renderForbiddenPage
operations.description: Renders the forbidden-access page UI. When routed to a restricted location without authorization, the component SHALL display a page communicating that access is forbidden.

scenarios.name: Unauthorized access

scenarios.then: A page indicating that access is forbidden is displayed to the user

scenarios.given: Any application StateSchema state
scenarios.then: It renders deterministically without requiring user-specific data

operations.name: exportPublicApi
operations.description: Re-exports the ForbiddenPage component as a named export from the module barrel (src/pages/ForbiddenPage/index.ts), so consumers MUST import it via the public API rather than internal paths.

scenarios.name: Barrel export availability
scenarios.given: The ForbiddenPage module exists with its UI component as default export of ./ui/ForbiddenPage
scenarios.then: The ForbiddenPage UI component is resolved as a named export

services.name: Icon
services.purpose: Shared UI component that renders SVG icons with consistent styling and dimensions, supporting both static display and clickable (button-wrapped) interaction modes.

services.name: Input
services.purpose: Reusable shared UI text input component that renders a styled, theme-aware input field with optional label, left/right addons, size variants, autofocus, readonly mode, and focus-state styling.
sideEffects: Manipulates browser DOM focus state on the input element
Renders to the browser DOM

services.name: LangSwitcher
services.purpose: UI feature component that lets the user switch the application's interface language (English/Russian) by toggling the active i18n locale and displaying a localized trigger button.

operations.name: render
operations.description: SHALL render a clickable switcher control labeled with the translated language caption, optionally in an abbreviated (short) form.

scenarios.name: Full label rendering
scenarios.given: Component rendered without short flag
scenarios.then: The full translated language label is shown on the button
and: Clicking the button triggers language toggling

scenarios.name: Short label rendering
scenarios.given: Component rendered with short = true
scenarios.then: An abbreviated language label is shown to save space

scenarios.name: Custom styling
scenarios.given: A className is provided
scenarios.then: The custom class is applied to the component root alongside base styles

operations.name: toggleLanguage

scenarios.then: Interface language changes to 'en' and translated UI text updates

scenarios.name: Switch English to Russian
scenarios.given: Current i18n language is 'en'
scenarios.then: Interface language changes to 'ru' and translated UI text updates

scenarios.name: Repeated toggling
scenarios.given: User clicks the switcher multiple times
scenarios.then: Language alternates between the supported locales without error

May persist the selected locale to localStorage via i18n language detection

services.name: Loader
services.purpose: Presents an animated ellipsis loading indicator (four CSS-animated dots) to signal that asynchronous content is being loaded. Marked as deprecated in favor of the redesigned UI components.

scenarios.then: The resulting container includes both the base 'lds-ellipsis' class and the provided custom class
and: The base class 'lds-ellipsis' is never removed by the custom className

scenarios.name: Animation visible while loading
scenarios.given: The Loader.scss styles are loaded
scenarios.when: The component is mounted in the DOM
scenarios.then: The four dots animate via the lds-ellipsis1/2/3 keyframes to visually indicate ongoing loading

scenarios.name: Theme-aware dot color

operations.name: deprecationMarker

scenarios.given: The Loader module is inspected or imported in an IDE

scenarios.then: Tooling surfaces the @deprecated warning directing consumers to the redesigned components folder

services.name: MainLayout

services.name: NavbarWidgetPublicApi

scenarios.name: Navbar is importable from widget root
scenarios.given: The './ui/Navbar' module defines and exports the Navbar component

services.purpose: Feature module exposing the ThemeSwitcher UI component as the public API of the theme-switching feature, letting users toggle the application's visual theme.

operations.name: exportPublicApi
operations.description: The module SHALL re-export the ThemeSwitcher component from its ui implementation (ui/ThemeSwitcher) as the sole public export of the feature, so consumers import only from the feature barrel.
outputs: ThemeSwitcher: React component exported from ui/ThemeSwitcher

scenarios.name: Import via feature barrel
scenarios.given: The ui/ThemeSwitcher module exports a ThemeSwitcher component
scenarios.then: The same component exported by ui/ThemeSwitcher is resolved

scenarios.name: Encapsulated internals
scenarios.given: The feature barrel file is inspected
scenarios.then: Only the ThemeSwitcher component is exposed and internal implementation files remain hidden

scenarios.name: Missing implementation export
scenarios.given: ui/ThemeSwitcher does not export a ThemeSwitcher binding
scenarios.when: The feature barrel module is compiled
scenarios.then: A build/resolve error is surfaced rather than an undefined export

operations.name: toggleTheme
operations.description: The ThemeSwitcher component SHOULD toggle the active application theme (e.g., light/dark) when the user activates it, delegating theme state changes to the theme context/provider. (Inferred from the feature's purpose; implementation lives in ui/ThemeSwitcher which is not included in the provided data.)
outputs: Updated theme value applied to the application

scenarios.name: Switch to dark theme
scenarios.given: The application is currently in the light theme
scenarios.then: The application theme changes to dark

scenarios.name: Switch back to light theme
scenarios.given: The application is currently in the dark theme
scenarios.then: The application theme changes to light

dependencies: Shared UI kit components (Button, Icon) used by ui/ThemeSwitcher
sideEffects: Updates the application theme (root element classes/CSS variables) via the theme provider
May persist the selected theme choice (delegated to the theme provider)

services.name: UISlice
services.purpose: Encapsulates UI runtime state in the Redux store (primarily per-page scroll positions) and exposes the feature's public API: the UISchema type, the uiReducer, uiActions action creators, and the getUIScrollByPath selector.

operations.name: setScrollPosition
operations.description: Redux action creator exposed via uiActions; the reducer MUST record the scroll position for a given route path so pages can restore scroll position when the user returns.
outputs: Redux action ui/setScrollPosition with payload { path, position }

scenarios.name: Record scroll for a new path
scenarios.given: UI state has no scroll entry for path '/articles'
scenarios.when: setScrollPosition is dispatched with { path: '/articles', position: 250 }
scenarios.then: state.ui.scroll['/articles'] equals 250

scenarios.name: Overwrite existing scroll position
scenarios.given: UI state has scroll['/articles'] = 100
scenarios.when: setScrollPosition is dispatched with { path: '/articles', position: 400 }
scenarios.then: state.ui.scroll['/articles'] equals 400

operations.name: getUIScrollByPath
operations.description: Selector that SHALL return the saved scroll position for a given path from the root StateSchema, defaulting to 0 when no position has been recorded.

scenarios.name: Path with saved scroll position
scenarios.given: Root state contains ui.scroll['/about'] = 320
scenarios.then: returns 320

scenarios.name: Path without saved scroll position
scenarios.given: Root state has no scroll entry for '/unknown'
scenarios.then: returns 0

operations.name: uiReducer
operations.description: Redux slice reducer that MUST apply UI actions to the UISchema state, producing the next immutable state and leaving state unchanged for unknown actions.

scenarios.name: Applies scroll position action
scenarios.given: Initial UI state with empty scroll map (ScrollSchema)
scenarios.then: returns a new state where scroll[path] = position
and: the previous state object is not mutated

scenarios.name: Ignores unrelated actions
scenarios.given: Any UI slice state
scenarios.when: reducer receives an unknown/unrelated action type
scenarios.then: returns the same state unchanged

sideEffects: Writes UI slice state (scroll positions per path) to the in-memory Redux store

services.name: Sidebar
services.purpose: Application navigation sidebar widget that renders navigation links, supports collapse/expand toggling, and hosts the theme and language switchers.
sideEffects: Updates local component state (collapsed) on user interaction
Triggers DOM class changes on the sidebar element

services.name: SidebarItem
services.purpose: Renders a single navigation link in the sidebar with an icon and translated label, adapting its appearance to the sidebar's collapsed state and highlighting the active route.
sideEffects: Triggers client-side navigation when the link is clicked
